app.title: Show HN: Ito – Build Terminal UIs in Lua
app.author: cat-whisperer
app.description: Ito is a lightweight Lua library for building terminal user interfaces, inspired by curses and modern TUI paradigms.
proposed_tests: Install Ito via LuaRocks and run a simple hello-world TUI example.
Create a TUI with a menu and capture user input; verify output rendering.
Measure initialization time of a 100-line TUI application.
Run a benchmark that renders 1000 frames per second and check performance.
